evidence.observation: Reboiler reads ~446-449 °C, physically implausible vs all other stages at 63-77 °C, and drifts monotonically upward
Reflux and distillate flows essentially zero/noise (0-1.8 L/h) throughout, while FYI702 reports a steady ratio ~6-7, inconsistent with the measured flows
Slow oscillating temperature waves with no net separation profile developing; T711/T712/T705 frozen at 64.3/63.5/63.4

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature check (or thermowell verification) and a confirmed takeoff/reflux flow calibration; plus a distillate composition sample to test separation.
